ns2:course.label: Research Methods II
ns2:course.description: Second semester of the optional Capstone experience for International/Global Studies students. Designed to guide the interpretation of the data, development of conclusions and implications. In addition to the final project, students will learn how to write a paper abstract and conference proposal, as well as acquire presentation skills. 1 undergraduate hour. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: GLBL 494.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 1 undergraduate hour. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: GLBL 494.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Global Studies or Global Studies major(s).
